{{Quote|We've already lost one patrol... we figure the rakghouls got them. We've had so many encounters with those things we've actually run out of rakghoul serum.|A Sith Patrol Leader|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Sith trooper''' who served in [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] carried a vial of [[Rakghoul serum]] during a mission to the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. After they perished, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] recovered the serum and gave it to the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Zelka Forn]].
